nominal_voltage_class.notes: Quick web lookup (rough, not cross-checked). Charges at about 800 V.

Estimated: "800v" follows the class already stored for the Silverado EV Extended Range records. GM's guide gives 670 V (a charging voltage) for the 20-module pack and 800 V for the Max Range; The Weekly Driver gives 290 V nominal for the 20-module pack. OWNER FLAG: the class is a judgement (charging voltage vs nominal voltage); kept 800v to match the existing records.

chemistry.notes: thinkEV lists NMC for the 2026 Silverado EV (model level); InsideEVs also describes the Silverado pack as NMC pouch cells. Not trim-specific.
Estimated: InsideEVs describes the Silverado EV pack as NMC pouch cells (24-module pack); thinkEV lists NMC for 2026; same Ultium cells in all pack sizes.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: 2025 LT Extended Range has a 170 kWh pack (bare capacity, treated as gross); Wikipedia agrees. WT Extended assumed to use the same Extended pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Extended Range pack as 170 kWh "as published"; GM does not say whether this is usable or total, so it may be a gross figure (Green Cars Compare, search snippet only, lists 173 kWh usable). Scaled check: 204 kWh x 20/24 modules = 170 kWh (module counts from the GM 2026 Silverado EV guide).

dc_max_kw.notes: GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. 670 V up to 300 kW. Several existing Extended Range records say 350 kW (the Max pack's value); this is the GM figure for the 20-module pack. The Weekly Driver 20-module page also gives 300 kW. The existing 350 kW on some 2026 Extended Range records is the Max Range figure.

ac_max_kw.notes: GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. 2026 WT guide: 19.2 kW module on 5WT Extended Range.

published_10_80_min.notes: GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Extended Range (20 MOD) pack. Low-80% time to charge 42 min and 111 miles added in 10 min; column mapping to this pack inferred from the page layout (4WT 74 mi, 5WT 111 mi, 8WT 124 mi). The guide row is labelled "Low-80% time to charge", not 10-80 %.
